summary: The SDK has a pure model of deferred background tasks (requests, a pending queue and the rule for which may run now) and a background activity schedule with an interval and tolerance. Nothing in the shell or the SDK calls the scheduler on this branch, so no app task runs in the background. Continuous and continued tasks are missing. iPadOS 13.0 and later per the index; not tested on a tablet.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run this round; owner rule); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: Requests and a pending queue are modelled; no caller submits them to the shell.
The rule for which request may run now is modelled; the task types are not wired to a run loop.
An activity runs no sooner than its interval and at latest within a tolerance; not connected to the shell scheduler.
A download model exists; background transfer across launches is not verified.
No task that continues after the app is backgrounded.
No GPU budget for background work.

features.apple: Starting and terminating tasks during development
features.note: No debugger hook to run or stop a task.

gaps: No caller for the scheduler: the shell does not run app tasks in the background on this branch.
No continued processing task and no background GPU budget.
No development hook to start or stop tasks.
